ns0:svg.ns0:title: Replicated error and cost comparison with trade-study
ns0:svg.ns0:desc: Ten synthetic sample-mean designs compared across 512 paired replicates. Nondominated mean error and assumed cost are marked, and empirical errors are compared with analytic variances. Costs are declared assumptions, not measured field costs.
